name: Infantry_Settings
author: Infantry AI
description: Project config tools (per-role caps, routing rules, experiments, project data) and scoped settings tools. Daemon half only.

config.title: Notification sounds
config.applies: Applies to: the sound a notice plays. None (the default) plays nothing.

fields.label: Milestone sound
fields.description: The sound of a milestone ticket's notification when the ticket names none.

fields.label: Default notification sound
fields.description: The sound of a notification that names none.

fields.label: Incoming comms sound
fields.description: Played on this device when a mail arrives.

fields.label: Info notice sound
fields.description: Played on this device when a info notice arrives.

fields.label: Success notice sound
fields.description: Played on this device when a success notice arrives.

fields.label: Warning notice sound
fields.description: Played on this device when a warning notice arrives.

fields.label: Error notice sound
fields.description: Played on this device when a error notice arrives.

fields.label: Urgent notice sound
fields.description: Played on this device when a urgent notice arrives.

config.title: OS notifications
config.applies: Applies to: the desktop OS notifications for notices routed to the OS.

fields.label: Only while the app is in the background
fields.description: On: no OS notification while the app window has focus (the in-app toast still shows). Off: always.

tools.name: infantry_project_config_get
tools.description: Read a project per-role caps on concurrent agents (a role not listed runs 1) and its task routing rules.

tools.name: infantry_project_config_set
tools.description: Set a project per-role caps, autoRemoveDoneWorkers, routingRules (replace), experiment switches or generic project data.

tools.name: infantry_project_delete
tools.description: Delete a project and its workspaces. Refused while a session of the project is live unless force is true. Tickets and sessions are not touched.

force.description: Delete even though a session of the project is live.

tools.name: infantry_settings_get
tools.description: Read a setting effective value and the scope it comes from (session > role > project > app > default).

project.description: The project id (scope project, or the project of a role).

role.description: The role id (scope role, with project).

explain.description: true: also print which scope wins and every layer.

tools.name: infantry_settings_set
tools.description: Set a setting at a scope (app, project, role or session) with the target ids.

value.description: The value as JSON text (true, 5, "notify", [..]); null clears it at a non-app scope.

scope.description: app (default) | project | role | session. Resolution: session > role > project > app > default.

project.description: The project id (scope project, or the project of a role).

role.description: The role id (scope role, with project).
